description: Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council is a Warwickshire district (stock-holding HRA landlord). District feeds are procurement-dominant: no ASC/children's Care Act direct payments (county function), so no REDACTED bucket expected. Default: procurement_paid. REDACTED rule retained defensively — suffix-tolerant regex costs nothing if the bucket is empty.

match.supplier_regex: ^(\[REDACTED\]|REDACT(ED)?([ \-,].*)?|NAME WITHHELD|PAYMENT TO AN INDIVIDUAL|PAYMENT TO INDIVIDUAL)$

rules.reason: Defensive: districts occasionally publish redacted rows (housing benefit / DHP recipients). Anchored regex avoids false positives on real suppliers.

Employer LGPS contributions to the Warwickshire County Council Pension Fund (NBBC's administering authority) — 81 rows / £1.89M labelled 'WCC PENSION FUND - CREDITORS'. Same treatment as Warwickshire CC's own WCC Pension Fund rows: payroll-related transfer, not procurement; keeps it out of HHI / supplier leagues.

Default for Nuneaton and Bedworth. Single payments-over-£500 feed, no PO/invoice split. NOTE: top supplier NABCEL (Nuneaton & Bedworth Community Enterprises Ltd, £15.3M) is a wholly-owned council trading company — kept procurement_paid pending Companies House PSC verification per the leisure-trust-vs-ALMO rule; revisit if verified wholly-council-commissioned.
